The '''Bator Bai system''' was located in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions. It was connected to the [[Kalgo system/Legends|Kalgo]] and [[Suliana system/Legends|Suliana systems]] by the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] and contained the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bator Bai]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bator Bai [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2009]], which placed the system in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
